info.name: Get all items related to LimitIncreaseRequests

params.name: compartmentId
params.description:
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the parent compartment.
Note: The tenancy is the root compartment.

params.name: service
params.description: Name of service that owns the limit.

params.name: lifecycleState
params.description: Lifecycle state of the limit increase request.

params.name: limitsIncreaseRequestId
params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the limit increase request.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'asc' or 'desc'. By default, it is ascending.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. You can specify only one sort order. The default order for `timeCreated` is descending.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items returned in a page.

params.name: page
params.description: The next page token.

items.docs:

params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the limit increase request.

items.docs:

params.description: The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the limit increase request.

info.name: Get all questionnaire questions for a given service and limit name. If they are not provider return a super set of questions.

params.name: compartmentId
params.description:
The [OCID](/iaas/Content/General/Concepts/identifiers.htm) of the parent compartment.
Note: The tenancy is the root compartment.

params.name: serviceName
params.description: The name of the service.

params.name: limitName
params.description: The name of the limit.

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: The sort order to use, either 'asc' or 'desc'. By default, it is ascending.

params.name: sortBy
params.description: The field to sort by. Both fields will sort alphabetically

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of items returned in a page.

params.name: page
params.description: The next page token.

items.docs:
Gets the fields for the specified service and limit name.
Service name is required if limit name is provided.
If limit name is not provided, returns all questions for the specified service.
If service name is not provided, returns all available questions.
For more information, see
[Creating a Limit Increase Request](/iaas/Content/General/service-limits/create-request.htm).
